# Config reference

<!-- Code generated by `go generate ./internal/config`; DO NOT EDIT. -->

## Example config

```toml
config_version = 1

[provider]
  model = ""
  fallback = []
  light = ""
  max_output = 8192
  send_attribution = false

[loop]
  max_iterations = 40
  max_wall_s = 900
  max_identical = 3
  turn_max_input_tok = 400000
  turn_max_output_tok = 32000
  parallel_tools = 4

[budget]
  turn_usd = 0.5
  session_usd = 5.0
  daily_usd = 0.0
  monthly_usd = 0.0
  warn_at = 0.8
  tools_session_usd = 1.0
  tools_daily_usd = 5.0
  gateway_user_daily_usd = 1.0
  [budget.providers]

[approval]
  mode = "ask"
  shell_allow = []
  deny_paths = ["~/.ssh", "~/.gnupg", "~/.aws", "**/.env", "**/*.pem", "~/.netrc", "~/.git-credentials", "~/.config/gh", "~/.docker/config.json", "~/.kube", "<config_dir>/secrets.enc", "<config_dir>/at-rest.*", "<config_dir>/backup.keys", "/proc/*/environ", "/proc/*/task/*/environ", "/proc/*/mem"]
  add_dirs = []
  preview_timeout_s = 600

[exec]
  default_timeout_s = 120
  idle_timeout_s = 60
  allow_destructive = false
  kill_grace_s = 3
  env_allow = []
  pass_ssh_agent = false
  backend = "local"
  [exec.env]
  [exec.backends]
    [exec.backends.docker]
      binary = "docker"
      image = ""
      user = "65534:65534"
      cpu_milli = 1000
      memory_mib = 512
      pids = 128
      network = "none"
      network_name = ""
      proxy_url = ""
      allow_unlimited = false
    [exec.backends.ssh]
      host = ""
      user = ""
      port = 22
      key_file = ""
      known_hosts = ""
      keepalive_s = 30
      idle_close_s = 600
      timeout_s = 120
      max_conns = 4

[agent]
  verify_on_stop = "run"

[skills]
  project_discovery = true
  trusted_projects = []
  external_dirs = []
  inline_shell = false

[sessions]
  auto_prune = false
  prune_after_days = 90

[context]
  compact_at = 0.75
  summary_max_tok = 600
  summaries_max_tok = 3000
  pinned_schema_tok = 3000

[memory]
  entry_max_chars = 500
  total_max_chars = 4000
  embeddings = ""

[recovery]
  continue = "safe_auto"

[ui]
  language = "auto"
  theme = "tern-dark"
  notices = true

[gateway]
  max_parallel_turns = 4
  busy_policy = "queue"
  [gateway.users]

[modules]
  [modules.gateway]
    [modules.gateway.telegram]
      thread_fallback = "fail"
  [modules.mcp]
    allow_sampling = false

[providers]
  custom = []

[log]
  level = "info"
  message_content = false
  message_content_ttl = "24h0m0s"

[storage]
  encrypt = false

[network]
  offline = false
  background = true

[toolsets]

[update]
  feed_url = ""
  channel = "stable"
  auto_install = false

[acp]
  use_client_fs = true
  use_client_terminal = false
```
